entities.name: Cruise missile strikes on Iraq
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Iraq was attacked with cruise missiles by the United States in June 1993. The strikes were ordered by U.S. president Bill Clinton as both a retaliation and a warning triggered by the attempted assassination of his predecessor George H. W. Bush by alleged Iraqi intelligence agents while on a visit to Kuwait from 14–16 April 1993.
